title: EventBus callback exception delivery isolation contract

contract.callback_exception_isolation: An exception raised by one callback does not abort EventBus delivery
contract.exception_containment: Callback exceptions are contained by EventBus.emit()
contract.delivery_continuity: Listeners after a failing callback continue receiving the active event
contract.delivery_order: Listeners continue in their registered order despite callback failure
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() returns true after a callback exception is contained
contract.registry_preservation: Callback failure does not modify the listener registry
contract.listener_preservation: The failing callback remains registered after its exception
contract.permission_enforcement: EventBus.emit() requires the events permission before delivery
